calendar_context: Memorial Day weekend (May 25 observed). 3-day federal holiday, Friday through Monday. Themes: veterans, military tributes, flag ceremonies (Willamette National Cemetery), start-of-summer outdoor push, Willamette Valley Memorial Day winery open house weekend, parades, patriotic music.

weather_summary.hillsboro: Sunny Friday–Sunday with highs 74–81°F, cooler Monday around 65°F with afternoon rain rolling in.
weather_summary.coast: Partly cloudy, highs 55–62°F, breezy. Borderline beach weather Fri–Sat; Sunday/Monday turn rainy with south winds gusting to 38 mph.
weather_summary.gorge: Mostly sunny, highs 73–77°F Fri–Sun, partly cloudy mid-70s Saturday. Prime Gorge weather with west winds 5–15 mph.
weather_summary.mt-hood: Sunny Fri–Sat with highs 56–59°F at Government Camp; Sunday brings rain/snow mix above 6,800 ft with breezy west winds gusting to 34 mph.

event.title: USA Dodgeball Premier Tour — Portland Stop
event.why: National competitive dodgeball tour stop with division-based brackets all day. High-energy, weird-enough-to-be-fun, easy walk-in spectator vibe. Perfect rainy-Sunday backup.
event.image_hint: USA Dodgeball tournament Portland Expo Center indoor courts crowd

featured_venues.name: Westside Commons (Wingspan Event Center)
featured_venues.where: 801 NE 34th Ave, Hillsboro (Wingspan Event & Conference Center)

event.title: Westside Comic Con — Washington County's first major pop-culture convention
event.why: Brand-new for 2026 and 5 minutes from home — gaming, vendor art booths, cosplay guests, a Geeklesque burlesque tribute Saturday night (18+). Weekend pass starts at $25. Teen-friendly during expo hours.
event.image_hint: comic con convention hall cosplay vendors gaming Hillsboro Westside Commons

event.title: Cultural Immersion Saturdays + AANHPI Heritage programming
event.when: Saturday May 23 — included with admission; live Chinese music Fridays noon–3pm
event.why: Final weekend of the Cultural Immersion Saturdays series, plus AANHPI Heritage Month events. Erhu, ruan qin, and pipa performances Friday in the courtyard. Tea house upstairs.
event.image_hint: Lan Su Chinese Garden Portland Ming dynasty pavilion koi pond stone pagoda

event.title: David Hockney exhibition + 'Monterey Pop' 4K Criterion screening
event.why: Hockney's Cali poolside paintings paired with the museum's 'Pretty, Witty and Gay' weekend film series. Sunday film matinee makes a clean rainy-Monday plan.
event.image_hint: Portland Art Museum gallery interior David Hockney California pool painting

Hockney exhibition + weekend Criterion film series. Surfaced as featured venue.
TITANIC: The Artifact Exhibition runs through May 31. Surfaced in items as rainy-day option.
Cultural Immersion Saturdays (final week), live Chinese music Friday. Surfaced as featured venue.
Open daily 9am–5pm, self-guided tours, but no special programming on the weekend dates. Volunteer event May 26.
Museum open regular hours (M–Sat 10–5, Sun 12–5) but no dated public events on the weekend. Obukan Judo Dojo and Oregon history exhibits available.

items.title: Memorial Day Ceremony at Willamette National Cemetery
items.when: Monday, May 25 — ceremony at 1pm; scouts plant 130,000 flags Saturday morning
items.where: 11800 SE Mt Scott Blvd, Happy Valley
items.why: The largest Memorial Day commemoration in the Pacific Northwest since 1950. Scouts of America place a flag at every one of the 130,000 graves Saturday — visually staggering. Monday ceremony draws thousands.
items.weather_rationale: Mostly cloudy with light rain possible Monday — outdoor ceremony goes regardless; bring layers.
items.image_hint: Willamette National Cemetery flags rows headstones Memorial Day Oregon

items.title: Oregon Vietnam Veterans Memorial — Reading of the Names
items.where: 4000 SW Canyon Rd, Washington Park (near Oregon Zoo), Portland
items.why: Every Oregonian killed or missing in the Vietnam War read aloud, followed by a brief ceremony at the spiral memorial walk. Quiet, deliberate, and 15 minutes closer than Willamette National.
items.weather_rationale: Cloudy with light rain Monday — outdoor but compact; under canopy of mature trees.
items.image_hint: Oregon Vietnam Veterans Memorial spiral walk Washington Park granite wall names

items.title: Memorial Weekend in Wine Country
items.where: Yamhill-Carlton, McMinnville, Dundee, Newberg AVAs
items.why: The big spring open-house weekend across Willamette Valley wineries. Barrel tastings, library releases, food trucks, member discounts for armed forces. Yamhill Valley Vineyards runs Sunday Funday May 23–25; Knudsen Vineyards has BBQ + Pinot pairings on the terrace Sat–Sun.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny mid-70s in the valley Fri–Sun — peak patio-tasting weather. Monday will be cooler and damp.
items.image_hint: Willamette Valley vineyard rolling hills tasting room patio wine glasses Pinot

items.title: Portland Saturday Market
items.where: Tom McCall Waterfront Park, 2 SW Naito Pkwy, Portland
items.why: The granddaddy of PNW open-air markets. Memorial Day weekend brings extra vendors and live music on the waterfront stage. Rose Festival CityFair is right next door — easy pair for the day.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny low 80s Saturday — outdoor-perfect.
items.image_hint: Portland Saturday Market white tents booths Willamette River Burnside Bridge crowd

items.title: Rose Festival CityFair Opening Night + Fireworks
items.where: Tom McCall Waterfront Park, 98 SW Naito Pkwy, Portland
items.why: Rose Festival kicks off Friday with a ribbon-cutting, 50+ live performances across the run, carnival rides, food vendors, and choreographed fireworks over the Willamette. $12 day-pass for rides. Best fireworks seat in the city.
items.weather_rationale: Warm Friday evening, low chance of rain — ideal carnival/fireworks night.
items.image_hint: Portland Rose Festival CityFair waterfront ferris wheel fireworks Willamette River Hawthorne Bridge

items.title: Multnomah County Fair at Oaks Park
items.where: Oaks Amusement Park, 7805 SE Oaks Park Way, Portland
items.why: Free admission ($4 parking). Three days of competitive exhibits, Portland Lucha Libre wrestling, pioneer village, wiener dog races, La Familia Day Sunday with Hispanic dancing. Stack with Oaks Park rides and the skating rink.
items.weather_rationale: Warm and sunny Sat–Sun, cooler with rain Monday — most of the fair is outdoor/tented.
items.image_hint: Multnomah County Fair Oaks Park amusement rides exhibits Portland family

items.title: Downtown Hillsboro Saturday Farmers Market
items.where: Main St between 1st and 3rd, Downtown Hillsboro
items.why: Five minutes from home and the most local thing on the list. Spring produce is rolling in — strawberries, asparagus, salad greens. Easy Saturday-morning move before the rest of the day.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny 79°F Saturday — peak market weather.
items.image_hint: Downtown Hillsboro Farmers Market Main Street tents fresh produce historic storefronts

items.title: Beaverton Farmers Market
items.where: 12375 SW 5th St, Beaverton
items.why: Largest all-agricultural farmers market in Oregon. Bigger vendor lineup than Hillsboro — nursery growers, ranchers, artisan bakers, cheese makers. Hit one or the other Saturday morning.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny morning — outdoor market goes ahead easily.
items.image_hint: Beaverton Farmers Market Saturday morning crowd produce stalls flowers downtown

items.title: Edgefield's History & Art Tour
items.where: McMenamins Edgefield, 2126 SW Halsey St, Troutdale
items.why: Guided walk through the 1911 Poor Farm grounds with stories behind the art, the buildings, and the murals tucked into every nook. Pair with dinner at the Black Rabbit. McMenamins-only Saturday programming.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny and warm — perfect for a walking tour outdoors.
items.image_hint: Edgefield Manor Troutdale historic poor farm brick building murals gardens

items.title: Grand Lodge Gardens — self-guided wander
items.when: Saturday or Sunday — gardens open daylight hours
items.where: McMenamins Grand Lodge, 3505 Pacific Ave, Forest Grove
items.why: 20 minutes from home and most Hillsboro folks have never wandered the Grand Lodge gardens. Rhododendrons should still be on display. Pair with lunch in the pub or a soak in the saltwater pool.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny and warm — peak garden weather.
items.image_hint: Grand Lodge Forest Grove historic Masonic building rhododendron garden footpath

items.title: Latourell Falls loop
items.where: Historic Columbia River Highway, near Corbett
items.why: Easy loop past the 249-ft Latourell Falls and a smaller upper falls. Less crowded than Multnomah on holiday weekends. Note: Gorge trails are slippery even on sunny days (a 72-year-old hiker fell here this week) — wear grippy shoes.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny and warm in the Gorge — perfect hike weather, but watch wet rocks near the falls.
items.image_hint: Latourell Falls Columbia Gorge 249 foot waterfall basalt columns moss

items.title: Tom McCall Preserve + Rowena Crest wildflowers
items.when: Saturday or Sunday — best in morning light
items.where: Tom McCall Preserve, 6656 Historic Columbia River Hwy, Mosier
items.why: Last call on peak wildflower season — balsamroot, lupine, paintbrush. 300+ plant species across the plateau. Drive the old highway loop with the famous Rowena Crest hairpin overlook. Lunch in Hood River after.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny and warm in the east Gorge — peak conditions, but it's exposed and windy.
items.image_hint: Rowena Crest Tom McCall Preserve yellow balsamroot purple lupine Columbia River bluff

items.title: Hood River waterfront + kiteboarding watch
items.where: Event Site & Waterfront Park, Hood River
items.why: Memorial Day weekend kicks off windsurf/kite season. Walk the waterfront, grab lunch at pFriem or Solstice, watch the river show. Pair with Tom McCall in the morning for a full Gorge day.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny 73–77°F Fri–Sun with steady west wind 5–15 mph — peak conditions on the river.
items.image_hint: Hood River waterfront Columbia River kiteboarders sails windsurf colorful Mt Adams backdrop

items.title: Manzanita beach walk
items.when: Friday or Saturday — Sunday/Monday turn rainy
items.where: Manzanita, OR
items.why: Long, quiet beach with the Neahkahnie headland framing the south end. Less of a circus than Cannon Beach on a holiday weekend. Stop in for fish and chips at Left Coast Siesta or wine at MacGregor's.
items.weather_rationale: Partly cloudy 60–62°F Fri–Sat with light winds — borderline beach weather, layered. Skip Sunday and Monday: rain and 38mph south gusts.
items.image_hint: Manzanita beach Oregon coast Neahkahnie headland low tide footprints

items.title: Trillium Lake loop + Mt. Hood views
items.where: Trillium Lake, near Government Camp
items.why: Flat boardwalk loop around a mirror lake with Mt. Hood reflected straight on. The campground is still snowed in but the day-use lot opens for the holiday weekend. Sunny Sat is the window before Sunday's snow chance.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny 56–59°F Fri–Sat at Government Camp — clear views of Hood. Sunday brings rain/snow above 6,800ft — skip late weekend.
items.image_hint: Trillium Lake reflection of Mount Hood snowy peak boardwalk pine trees foreground

items.title: Portland Underground (Shanghai Tunnels) tour
items.when: Saturday & Sunday — tours run on the hour, advance booking recommended
items.where: 120 NW 3rd Ave, Old Town Portland
items.why: Underground passages used in the 1800s for storage and (allegedly) shanghaiing sailors off the waterfront. Atlas-Obscura-grade weird history, indoors and dry. Perfect rainy-Monday backup.
items.weather_rationale: Indoor — perfect contingency for the rainy Monday forecast.
items.image_hint: Portland Shanghai Tunnels underground brick passage lantern Old Town

items.title: Freakybuttrue Peculiarium
items.where: 2234 NW Thurman St, Portland
items.why: Tiny museum of oddities — alien autopsies, cryptid displays, Bigfoot photo ops, a sasquatch ice-cream parlor. Wear a costume, get in free. Hailey and Logan will both find this entertainingly weird.
items.weather_rationale: Indoor — perfect any day, especially the rainy Sunday/Monday window.
items.image_hint: Freakybuttrue Peculiarium Portland storefront oddities Bigfoot alien autopsy display

items.title: Mill Ends Park — the leprechaun colony
items.when: Anytime — 2-foot circle on a Naito Parkway median
items.where: SW Naito Pkwy & SW Taylor St, Portland
items.why: Used to be the smallest park in the world per Guinness — 452 square inches. The only leprechaun colony west of Ireland. Five-minute stop, but it pairs perfectly with Saturday Market a block away.
items.weather_rationale: Outdoor but it's a 5-minute detour — works in any weather.
items.image_hint: Mill Ends Park Portland tiny circular park median Naito Parkway single tree miniature features

items.title: OMSI — Titanic: The Artifact Exhibition
items.when: Daily through May 31, regular OMSI hours
items.where: OMSI, 1945 SE Water Ave, Portland
items.why: 100+ authentic artifacts recovered from the wreck site — china, jewelry, personal items. Final week of the run. Pair with the planetarium or the USS Blueback submarine tour. Strong rainy-Monday option.
items.weather_rationale: Indoor — purpose-built for the wet Monday forecast.
items.image_hint: OMSI Titanic artifact exhibition recovered objects ship wreck museum gallery

items.title: Oregon Garden — 'Art in the Garden' Opening Day
items.when: Saturday May 23, opening day (runs through Sept 3)
items.where: 879 W Main St, Silverton
items.why: 80 acres of specialty gardens with a brand-new summer-long outdoor art installation kicking off Saturday. Local artists' handcrafted work scattered through the grounds. No upcharge over garden admission.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny mid-70s in the valley — peak garden weather.
items.image_hint: Oregon Garden Silverton botanical paths flowering rhododendrons summer art sculpture installation

items.title: Bush's Pasture Park + Deepwood Museum
items.where: Bush's Pasture Park, 600 Mission St SE, Salem
items.why: Historic 90-acre park with one of Oregon's best rose collections (likely peak bloom), a Victorian mansion museum (Bush House), and the Deepwood Museum's English-style gardens next door. Salem's quiet weekend gem.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny in Salem Sat–Sun — outdoor garden weather.
items.image_hint: Bush's Pasture Park Salem Oregon rose garden Victorian mansion historic walkway

items.title: Reb & the Good News with The Weather Machine
items.where: Aladdin Theater, 3017 SE Milwaukie Ave, Portland
items.why: Portland Americana / rock outfit fronted by Reb (of Blitzen Trapper). The Weather Machine opens — folk-rock with horns. Small, listening-room vibe at the Aladdin. Date-night-shaped.
items.weather_rationale: Indoor venue — doesn't matter.
items.image_hint: Aladdin Theater Portland marquee historic SE Milwaukie band stage lights crowd

items.title: Sellwood Antique Row crawl
items.when: Saturday or Sunday afternoon — most shops 10am–6pm
items.where: SE 13th Ave between Tacoma and Bidwell, Portland
items.why: Two dozen antique shops along a few walkable blocks, plus the two Stars Antique Malls across the street from each other on Milwaukie Ave. Wander, hunt, then grab lunch at Jade Bistro or a beer at Gigantic. Indoor backup for rain.
items.weather_rationale: Mostly indoor — works whether it's sunny Saturday or rainy Monday.
items.image_hint: Sellwood Antique Row Portland storefront vintage signs displays mid-century furniture
